1. Goal of the app: Team task tracker for small agencies (5–30 people). Core job: assign tasks, track status, and keep client work private per workspace. Out of scope v1: billing, mobile native apps, public marketing site.
2. Tech and Research:
Project type: Web App.

Competitors (research): Asana, Linear, ClickUp, Trello, Notion, Monday.com, Jira, Height, Plane, Focalboard, Basecamp, Todoist Business.
Most-used patterns: board + list views, assignees, due dates, comments, workspace/project hierarchy, keyboard shortcuts (Linear).
Evidence: knowledge-work tools converge on status workflows + notifications; no peer-reviewed study claimed for this niche — No supporting studies found for this feature (agency-specific SLA boards).
UI patterns: dense but calm SaaS; left nav; board columns; clear empty states.

Stack recommendation: React + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui; Postgres (or D1) with row-level security; email magic-link or OAuth login.

Security baseline (auto-injected):
- Auth required for all app routes except /login and /signup.
- Multi-tenant: every row scoped by workspace_id; RLS (or equivalent query filters) so users only read/write their workspace.
- Roles: owner, member, client_guest (read-limited).
- PII: email, name — minimize; no logging of full tokens; secrets only in server env.
- Deny by default for private tasks; audit soft-delete.
3. Features and KPIs:
MVP features:
1) Workspace + invite members
2) Projects with task board (Todo / Doing / Done)
3) Task CRUD: title, assignee, due date, description
4) Comments on tasks
5) Basic notifications (in-app)

KPIs (testable):
- Time-to-first-task < 3 minutes after signup
- ≥80% of created tasks have an assignee within 24h (sample workspace)
- Zero cross-workspace data leaks in access tests
- Board load < 2s for 200 tasks (local/staging)
4. Pages and navigation:
### Login `/login`
- Purpose: authenticate existing users
- Primary actions: Sign in (email/OAuth), link to Sign up
- Data entities: session, user
- Authz: public
- Empty/error: invalid credentials message; rate-limit notice
- Nav: → `/signup`, after success → `/app`

### Sign up `/signup`
- Purpose: create account + first workspace
- Primary actions: Create account, Create workspace name
- Data: user, workspace
- Authz: public
- Empty/error: email taken; weak password guidance
- Nav: → `/login`, after success → `/app`

### App home `/app`
- Purpose: list projects for current workspace
- Primary actions: New project, Open project, Switch workspace (owner)
- Data: projects[], workspace, membership
- Authz: member+
- Empty: “No projects yet” + CTA New project
- Error: workspace access denied
- Nav: → `/app/projects/:id`, `/app/settings`

### Project board `/app/projects/:id`
- Purpose: manage tasks on a board
- Primary actions: Add task, Move column, Edit task, Assign, Comment
- Data: project, tasks[], comments[]
- Authz: member+; client_guest read-only
- Empty: empty column placeholders
- Error: project not found / forbidden
- Nav: ← `/app`, → `/app/projects/:id/tasks/:taskId`

### Task detail `/app/projects/:id/tasks/:taskId`
- Purpose: full task + comments
- Primary actions: Save, Delete (member+), Add comment
- Data: task, comments, assignees
- Authz: member+ write; client_guest read
- Empty: no comments yet
- Error: 404/403
- Nav: ← board

### Settings `/app/settings`
- Purpose: workspace members, roles, danger zone
- Primary actions: Invite, Change role, Remove member
- Data: members[], invites
- Authz: owner for role changes; member view
- Empty: only you in workspace
- Error: cannot remove last owner
- Nav: ← `/app`
5. UI/UX design:
- Mood: calm professional, light-first
- Palette: bg #F7F8FA, surface #FFFFFF, text #0F172A, accent #2563EB, success #16A34A, danger #DC2626, border #E2E8F0
- Typography: Inter/Geist sans; 14px body; 20–24px page titles
- Density: medium; 8px spacing scale
- Radius: 8px cards/buttons
- Motion: 150ms fades; no decorative parallax
- Components: shadcn + Tailwind; left sidebar nav; board columns
- Nav pattern: collapsible left rail (Projects, Settings)
- States: skeleton loaders; explicit empty CTAs
